observations.description: Wide midfield view, scoreboard reads BET 1-0 BAR at 10:09. Ball is near the right side of the pitch around a Barcelona player in orange, well outside the penalty area.
Barcelona carry the ball through the right-centre of the attacking third, outside the Betis penalty area; several Betis defenders are ahead of the carrier.
A Betis defender challenges the Barcelona ball carrier on the right outside the penalty area. Contact is visible; no foul decision is shown.
Barcelona have the ball wide on the right outside the Betis penalty area; no shot or cross is yet visible.
Barcelona retain the ball outside the Betis penalty area. Several Betis defenders hold positions in and around the box, with Barcelona players spread across the width.
Two Barcelona players combine on the right outside the penalty area. The orange number 23 is visible running alongside his teammate. This identifies his involvement here, not the later deliverer.
The Barcelona runner on the right is inside the penalty area with the ball ahead of him and a Betis defender alongside; a teammate is running toward the goalmouth.
A Barcelona player delivers the ball from the right side of the penalty area toward a teammate arriving in front of goal. The delivery travels across the six-yard area; no exact body-part claim.
Ball struck from close range inside the six-yard area, visible just in front of the goalkeeper who is diving/sprawling; bodies of defenders on the ground nearby.
The ball is clearly inside the net behind the beaten goalkeeper. This is the first sampled frame clearly showing a goal.
Close-up of a Barcelona player in orange wearing number 7 running and pumping his fist in celebration.
Cut to the touchline: a coach in all black gestures in the technical area; the on-screen score now reads 1-1, indicating the goal was given (goal moment itself not shown in this window).
Scorer caption appears showing Barcelona number 7 'FERRAN — GOLES 1'; the player is shown in close-up glancing to his side.
